_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your own paths and ids. Every value here is a placeholder or empty; the skill will stop and ask if it needs something you have not set.

zotero._api_comment: db_path/data_dir are used by the lookup scripts. user_id and api_key are only used by zotero_write.py: create a key at https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys with library access + write access (+ notes access if you also write child notes).
zotero._collection_comment: Every item the skill writes is filed into this collection. Notion is the source of truth; the collection is only the boundary of what to back up and audit. Set to "" to file nothing.

notion._mcp_comment: Required publication target. Install/connect the official Remote Notion MCP at https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, complete OAuth, then run the read-write probe in reference-notion.md. A local note is not a completed fallback.
notion._properties_comment: Maps the skill's fixed concept names to the actual field names in your papers database. If a concept here has no matching field in the database, the skill stops and reports it rather than dropping the value.
notion._option_values_comment: The legal values of the select fields. Type and verdict are set by the skill.

feishu._app_comment: Optional second publish target. Create a self-built app at https://open.feishu.cn (name it after the skill), then copy App ID / App Secret from 凭证与基础信息. Add scopes drive:drive, docx:document, bitable:app, wiki:wiki, then 创建版本并发布 (create a version and release it) -- scopes take no effect until a version is published. Keep app_secret in config.local.json or FEISHU_APP_SECRET -- never here.
feishu._domain_comment: Your tenant host, e.g. acme.feishu.cn. Only used to build human-clickable links; run scripts/feishu_setup.py to fill it in.
feishu._workspace_comment: Filled in by scripts/feishu_setup.py. The base holds the 论文 Papers table; the docx bodies live under folder_token. Leave empty and setup creates them.

_tag_prefix_comment: Zotero tags are flat, so the data family is carried by a prefix. Notion uses one multi-select field and needs no prefix.
